plain.li: [found:wilt] That {THING} is wilting, and the ones beside it will catch it.
[found:wilt] Look at those leaves, the {THING} has the wilt.
[found:wilt] Brown leaves in the growing season, that's wilt in the {KIND}.
[found:rust] This grass is covered in orange dust, it's rust.
[found:rust] Don't walk through that grass, it has the rust and you'll carry it on your boots.
[found:rot] These berries are rotting on the bush, and the bush with them.
[found:rot] The berry bushes have the rot, there'll be nothing to pick here this year.
[burn] Stand back, once it catches it will go quickly.
[burn] Burn the sick ones out and the ground will grow clean.
[burn] Keep an eye on the wind while it burns.
[wilt] This wilt is {GOD}'s doing, trees don't sicken like this on their own.
[wilt] {GOD} sent this into the wood, and {GOD} will take it away again.
[rust] The old people would have called this rust on the grass {GOD}'s mark.
[rust] {GOD} has laid a hand on the grass, that's what this rust is.
[rot] {GOD} takes the berries this year, that's what the rot is.
[rot] Rot like this comes from {GOD}, and we'd do well to remember it.
[woods] {GOD} has given us the wood back.
[woods] That's {GOD}'s work, young trees standing where the ground was bare.
